hints.content:
To measure slope, we pick any two points on the line. Then we look at the horizontal and vertical distances between those points.



[[☃ image 1]]

options.alt: A coordinate plane. The x- and y-axes each scale by one. A graph of a line intersects the points negative four, negative three and negative one, negative two. There is a horizontal dotted segment from negative four, negative three to negative one, negative three that is labeled three. There is a vertical dotted segment from negative one, negative three to negative one, negative two that is labeled one.

hints.content:
Going from the point on the left to the point on the right, the change in $y$ is $\purpleD 1$, and the change in $x$ is $\redD 3$.

$\text{Slope}=\dfrac{\purpleD{\text{rise}}}{\redD{\text{run}}}=\dfrac{\purpleD{\Delta y}}{\redD{\Delta x}}=\dfrac{\purpleD{1}}{\redD{3}}$
The slope of the line is $\dfrac{1}{3}$.
